description: T08070_上水道配水量の分析 [drinking water supply] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 熊本市. 熊本市水道事業（上水道）の配水量等の推移 ※2012年度～2021年度 ※出典は『熊本市統計書』と記載して下さい。. Coverage: 熊本市. The portal files it under the publisher 熊本市. Its tags are 上水道, 熊本市統計書, 統計情報, 配水量. It offers 2 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-05-29 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Public Data License 1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
